critical_code_review_comments: LongWaitAlert component correctly implements portalType prop - 'staff' shows only Snooze, 'doctor' shows both Ready to Consult and Snooze
LongWaitAlert uses 30-minute threshold and calculates wait time from checked_in_at IST timestamp
Ready to Consult button calls onStartConsult which PUTs /api/diagyn-staff/appointments/{id}/status with status=WithDoctor
PortalErrorBoundary is a React class component with data-testid='error-boundary' that catches errors and shows retry UI
Both DoctorPortalRedesigned.js and DiaGynStaffPortal.js wrap main content with PortalErrorBoundary
